meta.sourceOfTruth: Live MICHELIN Guide restaurant pages and official Michelin newsroom announcements
meta.starCounts: 5 three-star, 14 two-star, 50 one-star in the NYC all-starred list (checked 2026-11-25)
meta.importantTiming: Michelin's 2026 Northeast Cities ceremony is scheduled for 2026-12-14 (https://michelinmedia.com/pages/blog/detail/article/c/a1479/), after this research date and before the proposed trip. Distinctions may change.
meta.priceNote: As of 2026-11-25, fixed menu prices from official restaurant-owned pages are shown as the arithmetic total for two adults (2 × the published per-person rate), with the named service/menu basis. This is a current menu snapshot, not a February 2027 quote; menus may change before travel. Optional drinks, pairings, supplements, tax and service are not added unless explicitly stated. Blank means no suitable fixed-price couple total was confirmed from an official source; see row flags. The officialUrl field links directly to the restaurant menu/source where a price was confirmed.
meta.hoursCrossCheck: Le Bernardin, Eleven Madison Park, Per Se and Atera were read independently by two sessions against the same MICHELIN records on 2026-11-25 and agree. The fuller capture (which includes Le Bernardin Thursday to Sunday and 'Sunday closed') is retained. Independent agreement is the strongest verification available without a second source.
